thread:
Aisha K.: Heads-up — canary (model v2.7.3) showing 8-12% token p99 increase on /generate for batch shapes with long prompts (seq_len ~1024, batch 1-4). Saw kernel_selection choose 'fused-attn-v2' but token time jumps. Flame link: https://internal/g/fg/123 (redacted)

Marco L.: :eyes: can you paste the kernel decision logs? Is it picking fused because memory_est > threshold?

Aisha K.: pasted log:
```
[2026-03-18T09:12:00Z] kernel_choice=fused-attn-v2 reason=estimated_peak(9.1GB)>mem_threshold(8GB) fallback=false
[2026-03-18T09:12:00Z] batch_shape=(1,1024) kv_cache_hit=true observed_seq=1024
```
Also attaching small perf flame and sample request histogram.

Priya S.: Quick profiling — when batchshape has many short-prefix tokens + KV hits, fused kernel loses out due to extra memcpy and less async overlap. I ran perf with `--kernel-debug` and saw ~12us extra per-token in the hot path for this workload.

InfraBot: Canary rollout: v2.7.3 -> 10% traffic at 09:05 UTC. Metrics: increase token_p99 +9.8% on /generate-route.

Marco L.: That matches. Two ideas: 1) tag requests with `batch_shape=(bs,seq)` at entry so we can slice metrics by shape; 2) add a per-kernel penalty term to kernel selection heuristic that uses recent token SLO violations.

Aisha K.: Agree on tagging. Current telemetry schema only records model, route, seq_len. Need `kernel_choice` and `batch_shape` fields so dashboards can break this down.

Priya S.: SQL to query current perf by kernel:
```
SELECT kernel_choice, batch_shape, percentile(latency_ms, 99) as p99
FROM token_latency
WHERE model_version='v2.7.3' AND route='/generate'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY p99 DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

Ash G.: I'll open a tiny PR to add the tags to the entry pipeline and a dashboard panel for kernel vs batch_shape. Assigning to @Marco for heuristic change. :thumbsup: 

Marco L.: I'll prototype heuristic: weight = base + alpha * recent_p99_violations(kernel). Can we store short-window (5m) p99 per-kernel? We have time-series for token latency, should be straightforward to ingest.

Aisha K.: Sounds good. For immediate mitigation, can we rollback fused-attn-v2 on canary? Or set threshold tighter?

InfraBot: Rollback scheduled by @ops for canary at 09:40 UTC — will cut fused-attn-v2 on 10% bucket.

Priya S.: FYI I added a small test harness: `bench/kernel-compare --shapes "1x1024,4x512,8x256"` and pushed results to s3://redwood-perf/v2.7.3/bench.json

Aisha K.: Great — please post the bench link in the ticket. I'll follow up with dashboard mockups.

Marco L.: I'll take the heuristic PR, add feature flag, and wire the short-window p99 source. ETA EOD.

Aisha K.: thanks all — :rocket:
